title: A general as sole defender does not protect when the flying general voids the recapture
rationale: mx-chs-006 with the black king moved d7 to c7, the single change, from where it defends c6 inside its own palace. The recapture c7c6 is illegal because it would leave the two kings facing on an otherwise empty c-file, so the cannon is as unprotected on c6 as it already is on c5 and the chasing side (Red) loses at the third occurrence.
